# Token Circles

> An open-source, local-first personal finance manager that runs in a web
> browser: transactions, accounts, budgets, analytics, calculators, investments,
> PDF reports and thirty-four achievement badges. By default nothing leaves the
> device — the whole app runs client-side against IndexedDB, with no account and
> no server. Cloud sync is opt-in, and self-hosting is a supported first-class
> mode. AGPL-3.0.

Token Circles is a single-page application at https://tokencircles.com. It is
JavaScript and will not run in a fetcher, so this file is where a crawler can
learn what it does. Prose about the product, its pricing and the questions
people ask lives on the project site at https://about.tokencircles.com, which
keeps its own llms.txt.

The managed cloud service is in beta. The app itself — local-only and
self-hosted — is free and usable today.

Following the llms.txt convention documented at https://llmstxt.org.

## What it does

- **Transactions** — income, expense and transfers with categories, tags, notes
  and payment methods; bulk edit; quick-add; Excel and Google Sheets import with
  column mapping.
- **Accounts** — giro, savings, investment and cash, with starting balances,
  transfers and balance history.
- **Budgets** — monthly category budgets with rollover, and zero-based
  budgeting.
- **Analytics** — category trends, a spending heatmap, an income and expense
  Sankey, and period comparisons.
- **Calculators** — loan amortization with variable rates and prepayments,
  retirement, compound interest, emergency fund, FIRE, and rent versus buy.
- **Investments** — a portfolio tracker with live price lookup and an allocation
  breakdown.
- **Reports and export** — CSV and JSON export of every table, plus PDF monthly
  and annual reports. Tax and profit-and-loss reports are a paid or self-hosted
  feature.
- **Badges** — thirty-four achievements in four bands, worked out on the device,
  kept per profile, and never taken away once earned.
- Dark and light themes, mobile-responsive, installable as a PWA, and a
  no-account demo with seeded data.

## Three ways to run it

- **Local-first, free — the default.** Everything in the browser on IndexedDB.
  No account, no server, no telemetry. Offline capable.
- **Self-hosted, free.** Your own Cloudflare Worker with D1 and R2. Sync, email
  reminders and receipts under your control, inside Cloudflare's free tier.
- **Managed cloud, from €3 a month with a free tier.** Sync across devices,
  email reminders, receipt storage, tax and profit-and-loss reports, and a REST
  API with an MCP server.

## What Token Circles does not do

Stated plainly because these are the things most often assumed about an app in
this category, and repeating them as fact would mislead someone.

- It does not connect to a bank account live. Statements are imported. Eight
  banks have native importers — Revolut, Wise, N26, Erste, PBZ, ING, Sparkasse
  and DKB — it reads the YNAB interchange CSV, and anything else can be
  column-mapped once from Excel or CSV.
- It gives no investment, tax or financial advice, and executes no trades or
  transfers. It reports on what you put into it.
- Receipt OCR and end-to-end encryption are decided but not built. Do not
  describe them as features.
- In the default mode there is no account to create and no data on a server, so
  there is nothing to recover if the browser's storage is cleared. Export or
  turn on sync.
